notes.title: ARTE celebrates 10 years of video games
notes.notes:
This October, we are celebrating 10 years working alongside talented artists and creators to come up with unique and original games!

To mark this milestone, we’re having a massive sale including all of our game catalogue, with discount going from 30% to 80% off!

Thank you for getting on this journey with us, here’s to many more games ! 🎂

Whether you are new to the ARTE Experience or have been there since the beginning, we want to thank you and let you know more about what’s to come, so stay tuned for all the big things to come !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5217430/5693e5d60af9ee41cab252b300ab6d2b1b79f846.png[/img]

notes.title: Type:Rider is on sale!
notes.notes:
Type: Rider is the very first game co-produced by ARTE France, in 2013!
Coproduced with Ex Nihilo, this puzzle game adventure let’s you play as two dots in a journey through typographic history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5217430/d75fdf68f64d8dd46d5bf3280f7b506edeb1abe2.png[/img]

From rock paintings to pixel art, ride your favorite fonts (Times New Roman, Pixel, Comic Sans) and solve riddles in a captivating atmosphere.

✈️🖋️💬

[b]Type: Rider is now 80% off![/b]

notes.title: French Indie Sale - Up To 80% Off Popular French Indie Games
notes.notes:
Celebrate top French independent game developers with the French Indie Sale, running today on Steam!

Organized by Seaven Studio together with over dozen other French indie developers, the promotion features 15 innovative French indie games. Pick from hits like Evoland, Fly’N, Strike Vector and gems like Tetrobot and Co., Type:Rider, Ethan: Meteor Hunter and many more!

All of these titles are discounted on Steam starting Sept 17 at 10 am Pacific Time for 48h only until Sept 19 at 10am Pacific time.

For more details, and the full list of titles on sale, please see http://store.steampowered.com/sale/frenchindiesale

notes.title: Type:Rider is available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Published by BulkyPix and developed by Ex Nihilo in association with ARTE France, the platformer Type:Rider is the latest indie phenomenon. We're happy to announce that the game is finally available on Steam. 

Immerse yourself in this enchanting experience to uncover the history and secrets of fonts and characters! 

Play as two dots and travel through the ages of typographic styles and techniques. 
From the rock paintings of prehistoric times to Pixel Art of the 2000’s, solve all the riddles by riding the most popular fonts and characters (Garamond, Helvetica, Times New Roman, Pixel, Comic Sans MS...) with a very captivating musical and visual environment. 

Are you ready for a journey across our History? 

Features: 
- Steam Play compatible (PC/Mac/Linux)
- 10 visually enchanting levels in Full HD with a unique sound design
- Breathtaking artworks taken from real archives
- Immersive and intriguing atmosphere 
- Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud and Steam Trading Cards supported
